segments.name: Cloud Fax
segments.description: Provides cloud fax, secure information exchange, healthcare interoperability and digital signature solutions to businesses, healthcare organizations, the public sector and individuals.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has determined that it operates one reportable segment known as Cloud Fax (see Note 16 - Segment Information).

revenueModel.text: Customers pay monthly recurring subscription and usage-based fees for cloud-based communication and digital signature solutions delivered as software they access without taking possession.
revenueModel.evidence: The contracts include both recurring subscription and usage-based fees, and the total transaction price is allocated to performance obligations in each contract as appropriate.
